examples.arabic: السيدة أم محمد، زبونة دائمة، اشتكت وقالت: 'ابني الصغير كان يشتري خمسة أرغفة خبز يومياً بعشرة آلاف ليرة، أما اليوم فنشتري ثلاثة فقط'.
examples.english: Mrs. Umm Mohammad, a regular customer, complained and said: 'My young son used to buy five loaves of bread daily for ten thousand liras, but today we only buy three'.
examples.transliteration: As-sayyida Umm Mohammad, zabouneh daa'imeh, ishtakat wa qaalat: 'Ibni as-sagheer kaan yashtari khamsat arghifeh khobz yawmiyan bi-'asharat alaaf leera, amma al-yawm fa-nashtari thalathah faqat'.
examples.storyTitle: Economic Broadcast: The High Cost of Living in the Levant

examples.arabic: سامي قال: يا ليلى، عنا خبز ببيتنا؟
examples.english: Sami said: Laila, do we have bread at our house?
examples.transliteration: Sami qal: Ya Laila, anna khobz bi baytna?

examples.arabic: هن أكلوا خبز تازه وحمص طيب.
examples.english: They ate fresh bread and delicious hummus.
examples.transliteration: Hinne akalu khubz taza wa hummus tayyeb.

examples.arabic: الجيران بيجيبوا خبز وزيتون ليتشاركوا مع العائلات ياللي خسروا بيوتهم.
examples.english: The neighbors bring bread and olives to share with the families who lost their homes.
examples.transliteration: el-jiran bijeebu khubez wa zaytun la-yitsharaku ma-a el-aylat yalli khisru buyuthum.
examples.storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

examples.arabic: بكل زاوية من الشوارع المهجورة، كانت ذكريات القذائف بتلاحق الناس، بس ريحة الخبز الطازة كانت بتعطيهم أمل مخبى.
examples.english: In every corner of the abandoned streets, memories of the shells were haunting the people, but the smell of fresh bread was giving them a hidden hope.
examples.transliteration: Bi-kull zawiya min al-shawari al-mahjoura, kanat dhikrayat al-qadha'if bit-lahiq al-nas, bass rihat al-khubz al-taza kanat bit-atihom amal mkhabba.
examples.storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

examples.english: We drink coffee and eat bread.
